description: ENHANCE 3D Virtual Reality Headset ? The Way of the Future. With the ENHANCE 3D VR Headset you can now experience Virtual Reality like never before. The headset is designed to hold any smartphone with a display size of 4-6 inches. Extra nose-padding, and an ultra soft foam interior lining will keep your face comfortable while you?re zipping by on roller coasters or navigating your way through the streets of Europe. Customize the fit of your headset with the elastic adjustable head strap that will provide plenty of support while you are immersed in an alternate universe. The sharp, crystal clear lenses will minimize the strain on your eyes and leave you feeling breathless. Openings on the sides allow you to plug your headphones, earbuds or micro USB cable into your smartphone so you control the volume to your liking while also being able to charge your phone! Its light and compact design lets you bring it with you when travelling on a long trip in the car or on a flight. The durable plastic headset will arrive at your door with no assembly required. Just place your smartphone inside and the magnetic clasp will hold it securely in place. Download VR games from Google Play and iTunes. Works With:.
